verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email inbox API, so thread snoozing and no-reply follow-up reminders are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no snooze feature and no reminder that resurfaces an unanswered thread. Labels used to track conversation state, along with webhooks and WebSockets, are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies
